    StartersNaboo floating fruitPear, rockmelon and honeydew cubes on toothpicks with honey and limeHow to make it2 pears1/4 rockmelon1/4 honeydew melon2 tbsp honey1 lime, juicedCut the pears, rockmelon and honeydew melon into cubes and spear on toothpicks.Drizzle with honey and lime and arrange on a long platter so they look like they're hovering.Geonosis arena wingsBaked wings tossed in chilli honey butter with sesame and spring onionHow to make it1kg chicken wings3 tbsp chilli sauce2 tbsp honey40g butter1 tbsp sesame seeds2 spring onions, slicedBake the wings at 220°C until crisp.Melt the chilli sauce, honey and butter and toss the wings through.Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion.Tipoca City salt and vinegar fish bitesThe ocean planet of Kamino, where it never stops rainingHow to make itAs written, serves 4Flathead pieces in a crisp salt and vinegar crumb, fried golden, with a sharp dill pickle and caper tartare and lemon wedges.Cut 600g flathead fillets into bite pieces and soak in 3 tbsp malt vinegar for 10 minutes, then pat dry.Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 100g panko mixed with 1 tsp salt.Fry at 180°C for 2 minutes until golden.Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped dill pickle, capers, dill and lemon juice.Sprinkle the fish with more salt and vinegar.Onion rings with chipotle mayoDex IDs the saberdart between orders.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsDex's Diner patty melts and friesBeef patty melts with onions and Swiss on rye, crinkle-cut friesHow to make it2 brown onions, sliced600g beef mince8 slices of rye bread4 slices of Swiss cheese50g butter1kg potatoes, cut into crinkle chips2 L vegetable oil4 dill picklesCook the onions slowly until golden.Shape the mince into 4 thin patties and sear. Layer on rye with the onions and Swiss.Butter the outside of the bread and grill until melted.Fry the potato chips in the vegetable oil on a low heat until soft, then again on a high heat until golden. Serve with pickles.Naboo meadow lamb cutlet picnicAnakin and Padmé on the grass at the Naboo lake retreatHow to make itAs written, serves 4Lamb cutlets grilled pink with rosemary and lemon, with a warm new potato salad, green beans and a bright salsa verde to spoon over.Boil 800g new potatoes until tender and halve.Blanch 300g green beans.Blitz parsley, mint, a garlic clove, 1 tbsp capers, 2 anchovies, lemon juice and 100ml olive oil into a salsa verde.Rub 12 lamb cutlets with oil, rosemary, lemon zest and salt and grill over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side.Toss the potatoes and beans with half the salsa verde and serve with the cutlets.SweetsClone trooper white chocolate mousseWhite chocolate mousse topped with cream and a dark chocolate squareHow to make it150g white chocolate100ml thickened cream, warmed, to melt the chocolate250ml thickened cream, plus extra to top, whipped1 egg white30g dark chocolate, shaved into thin squaresMelt the white chocolate into the warmed cream and cool.Whip the cream. Whisk the egg white and fold both through the chocolate mixture.Spoon into 4 glasses and set for 4 hours.Top with whipped cream and a thin square of dark chocolate.DrinksDex's diner coffeeStrong drip coffee in thick mugs, hot milk and raw sugar on the sideHow to make it60g ground coffee1 L water200ml milk, hot4 tsp raw sugarBrew the coffee with the water in a drip machine so it comes out strong.Pour into thick diner mugs and serve with hot milk and raw sugar on the side.Spiced blue milkDex knows a Kamino saberdart on sight.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
